title: Parent comparison job
purpose: Track the full comparison run across a record set, including block fields, total candidate pair count, skipped completed pairs, and remaining work.
resume_rule: A resumed job loads completed pair keys from checkpoint rows and removes them before leaf creation.
scale_note: Use one parent job per snapshot, partition, or source surface batch.

title: Blocking key row
purpose: Avoid full n x m comparison by grouping only plausible peers into deterministic or semantic blocks.
resume_rule: Block IDs are deterministic from job ID and block key so leaves can be regenerated.
scale_note: Start with deterministic blocking, then add embedding centroid or LLM-generated dimension buckets.

title: Leaf shard of pair keys
purpose: Give one worker a bounded set of pair keys that can be completed independently.
resume_rule: Workers write pair-level checkpoints; a later planner excludes completed pair keys.
scale_note: Tune leaf size by comparison cost, risk tier, and available worker memory.

title: Pairwise comparison result
purpose: Record a duplicate, conflict, supersession, or distinct decision with features and score.
resume_rule: Result IDs are deterministic from pair key so duplicate writes can be upserted.
scale_note: Store cheap lexical scores first, then attach embedding, cross-encoder, or LLM judge scores as dimensions.

title: Completed pair checkpoint
purpose: Let batch jobs pick up where they left off without recomparing completed pairs.
resume_rule: Any row with status completed suppresses that pair on subsequent planning runs.
scale_note: Checkpoints can live in JSONL, Postgres, object storage manifests, or queue ack tables.
